_note: r.164(3)(d) and (6)(d): "has income to be apportioned in accordance with provisions of section 10". s.10: a husband and wife governed by the community of property system ("COMMUNIAO DOS BENS", Portuguese Civil Code of 1860) in Goa, Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu; income under each head other than "Salaries" divided equally. The question's wording is drafted by Claude, to be adopted by the owner; the clause is quoted from the Gazette. Valid for TY 2025-26 and TY 2026-27 (W-090d, D-652 G1a): for TY 2025-26 it is Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.12(1)(a) proviso (IC), "section 5A" (Income-tax Rules, 1962, kept live by r.164(14)); the question names no section, so one wording serves both years.
question: Is your income divided between you and your spouse under the community-of-property system?

provenance.sourceDescription: Gazette CG-DL-E-20032026-271092, Income-tax Rules, 2026 r.164(3)(d), p.1662; r.164(6)(d), p.1663; Gazette CG-DL-E-22082025-265620, Income-tax Act, 2025 s.10, p.35; egazette 2018/184509, Income-tax (Second Amendment) Rules, 2018, G.S.R. 332(E), Income-tax Rules, 1962 r.12(1)(a) proviso (IC), p.177
